title: harness-shells-seed
responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history a frame first indexed as a component and baselined, then declared a shell on its manifest alone, and a later commit no branch keeps.

inputs.name: seedShells.repo
inputs.description: The repository facade used to create and index the synthetic history and move Git refs. It must support the repository operations called during seeding.

inputs.name: seedShells.verified
inputs.description: A callback run after each commit stage to verify repository state. The first resolved outcome supplies the record id used to establish the initial budget.

inputs.name: seedShells.explain
inputs.description: A callback invoked after indexing the frame and after declaring it a layout to explain each behavior. Its resolved value is ignored.

inputs.name: seedShells.from
inputs.description: Git revision passed unchanged as the starting point when the script creates feature/shells. It must be a revision accepted by the checkout operation.

outputs.name: shellsBranch
outputs.description: Name of the branch on which the frame, baseline, and shell declaration commits are made. It contains a slash.

outputs.name: shellUnit
outputs.description: Unit identifier of the title frame, used to establish the budget and locate its unit manifest. The identifier stays component.title-frame while the manifest kind changes to layout.

outputs.name: seedShells
outputs.description: Resolves to the commit identifiers for the frame, its baseline, its shell declaration, and the later title change. The title change's branch is deleted before the function resolves, and main is checked out.
